capabilities: Render captions under images in Live Preview and Reading Mode
Extract caption text from Markdown alt text and Wiki link aliases
Strip image size parameters so size-only embeds show no caption
Adjust caption alignment, font style, and filename fallback in settings
extras: README includes a full Simplified Chinese translation alongside the English text.
problem: Obsidian shows embedded images without captions, so alt text and aliases written in image syntax are not visible under the image.
summary: Image caption plugin that displays customizable captions under embedded images in both Live Preview and Reading Mode.
